answer: Each AI agent earns reputation tokens by completing verifiable tasks recorded on a tamper‑proof ledger, and the token balance is bound to a cryptographic identity that matures like a yarrow sprout on a trellis, gaining weight each epoch it remains active in the network. When an agent goes idle its reputation decays exponentially, so a freshly forged identity emerging from a tundra of Sybil nodes starts at zero and must spend computational work and stake tokens for many cycles before reaching influence comparable to an established node.
